body:
Reported Substance: ''Amanita Muscimol''
This occured end of autumn 2024. I happen to be very stressed at work, trying to ease it out microdosing psilocybin and then Amanita. I order gummies on a website, and start taking half a gummie before going to work, sometimes an entire one (5 mg). The effect is predictable, reproducible. Very warm feeling, a nice warmth, like an embrace.
One time, its a bit more, I go deeper. I believe it was in december 2024, reunion at work, Im stressed, I take an entire gummy.
The reunion goes fine, we were saying goodbye to a colleague leaving, we had breakfast together. But I start having flashes of some sort of maze, something that spirals down deep into my ear, about life itself, how it orginates. Its intriguing. I doesnt show on the outside. The reunion ends, I leave, still very calm despite the underlying agitation and this strange feeling left by the maze. Not bad, but also not good, a bit scary. It makes me shiver. I take the tram, I go to the endpoint, repeat. I was working until noon this day, the city was quiet, some still at the office, some at home; it was cold.
I'm sitting there, I cross the area we used to live in when I was child and I choose to not enter the maze. I understand it would take me places I dont want to go. Its the sirens trying to lure me out to sea but Im refusing, I understand. I love this place, the people I love are here, tho its really hard, tho love hurts so deep, I want to stay there, with them. I get back home, I see the sea, it sparkles, its golden, I shiver again and realize what I just experienced was not my normal state of being, that I had visions.
I dont stop taking Amanita after that. But the experience range is shrinked, which is fine by me. I get back the first feeling, warm, calm, like Im a cell among the countless others of this planet and in this vast universe, and that it is okay. Its home.
